description: Official Replicate API schema for ideogram-ai/ideogram-character

mask.title: Mask
mask.description: A black and white image. Black pixels are inpainted, white pixels are preserved. The mask will be resized to match the image size.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Random seed. Set for reproducible generation

image.title: Image
image.description: An image file to use for inpainting. You must also use a mask.

resolution.description: Resolution. Overrides aspect ratio. Ignored if an inpainting image is given.

style_type.description: The character style type. Auto, Fiction, or Realistic.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio. Ignored if a resolution or inpainting image is given.

rendering_speed.description: Rendering speed. Turbo for faster and cheaper generation, quality for higher quality and more expensive generation, default for balanced.

magic_prompt_option.description: Magic Prompt will interpret your prompt and optimize it to maximize variety and quality of the images generated. You can also use it to write prompts in different languages.

character_reference_image.title: Character Reference Image
character_reference_image.description: An image to use as a character reference.

title: ideogram-character Input Schema
